2608.24650.title: Simthesizer: An Agent-Driven Simulation Framework for LLM Serving Systems
2608.24650.paper_summary:
System-level simulation is an essential tool for exploring the rapidly expanding design space of LLM serving systems, where real deployments remain costly and often infeasible. However, modern LLM serving now evolves faster than human-driven simulator development can track, and emerging workloads and mechanisms, from agentic workflows to disaggregated serving, no longer fit the monolithic simulation pipeline that existing simulators assume. Each new mechanism therefore demands an invasive rewrite, leaving a widening development gap between deployed serving systems and the simulators that model them.
  To close this gap, we present Simthesizer, a framework that realizes agent-driven simulator development. Simthesizer introduces a composable simulator infrastructure that uniformly expresses the complete serving workflow, including the control decisions that coordinate it, and realizes it as a unified dynamic graph in Simthesizer simulator. Synthesizer agent, a harnessed coding agent, then lowers natural-language feature requests onto this abstraction under simulator-specific guardrails and fidelity validation, evolving one shared simulator instead of building a new one for every feature. Under the same coding agent and harnesses, extensions built on Simthesizer follow a vLLM-based real system with 2.51% average throughput error, versus 6.03% for extensions built on existing simulators. On identical workloads, Simthesizer also simulates up to 284.96x and 23.19x faster than two state-of-the-art simulators, LLMServingSim2.0 and Vidur, respectively.
2608.24650.paper_summary_zh: 系統級模擬是探索LLM服務系統快速擴展設計空間的重要工具，因為實際部署的成本高昂且往往不可行。<lb/>然而，現代LLM服務的演變速度已超過人力驅動的模擬器開發所能追蹤的範疇，從代理工作流程到分散式服務等新興工作負載和機制，已不再適合現有模擬器所假設的單體模擬管道。<lb/>因此，每一種新機制都需要進行侵入式的重寫，這使得已部署的服務系統與模擬它們的模擬器之間的開發差距不斷擴大。<lb/>為了縮小這一差距，我們提出了Simthesizer，一個實現代理驅動模擬器開發的框架。<lb/>Simthesizer引入了一個可組合的模擬器基礎設施，統一表達完整的服務工作流程，包括協調它的控制決策，並在Simthesizer模擬器中實現為一個統一的動態圖。<lb/>Synthesizer代理，一個被駕馭的編碼代理，然後在模擬器特定的護欄和真實性驗證下，將自然語言功能請求轉換為這一抽象，從而演變出一個共享的模擬器，而不是為每一個功能構建一個新的模擬器。<lb/>在相同的編碼代理和駕馭下，基於Simthesizer構建的擴展在vLLM基礎的真實系統上具有2.51%的平均吞吐量誤差，而基於現有模擬器構建的擴展則為6.03%。<lb/>在相同的工作負載下，Simthesizer的模擬速度也比兩個最先進的模擬器LLMServingSim2.0和Vidur分別快284.96倍和23.19倍。
